verdict.rationale: Ramp's travel page shows policy status on every booking option, so employees aren't left wondering whether a trip will be rejected. It also shows per-diem limits adjusted by location and duration, and Ramp books hotels and automatically rebooks them when the price drops. The CLI and MCP (trips:write) separately confirm in-platform travel booking. Missing for 10: flight booking is never explicitly named, there is no detail on hard blocks versus soft warnings or approvals for out-of-policy bookings, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.
